newsitem.title: EGYPT: Kuwait boycotts meeting chaired by Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait boycotts meeting chaired by Iraq.

text.p: Kuwait boycotted an Arab ministerial meeting in Cairo on Wednesday because Iraq, which occupied Kuwait for seven months in 1990 and 1991, unexpectedly took the chair, a Kuwaiti minister said.

The Kuwaiti minister of communications, electricity and water, Jassem al-Oun, told the Egyptian government newspaper al-Ahram that he had come to the meeting of Arab transport ministers on the understanding that Qatar would chair it.
He described the decision to give the chair to the Iraqi minister as a procedural error but the newspaper did not elaborate on how it came about.
The meeting, at Arab League headquarters in Cairo, discussed transport cooperation between Arab states.
Al-Ahram said the ministers condemned the U.N. sanctions imposed on Arab states such as Iraq and Libya.
